proposed_widenings.name: modify_carrying_capacity
proposed_widenings.justification: The current passive surface can encode the Grappled-escape advantage, but it has no effect atom for deterministic carrying-capacity changes or for treating a creature as one size larger when resolving capacity.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You also count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity.

notes: Partial fit only. The first clause maps cleanly to a passive species trait grant: modify_roll_advantage on ability_check with conditionFilter ["grappled"]. I did not author a partial unit because the carrying-capacity clause would be silently lost.
